# RITSEI v0.2.0

**Status:** Published pre-release\
**Source snapshot:** `72d233e006faaadee30a57b194b9752b32f79d68`\
**Commit date:** August 31, 2026
**Published:** August 31, 2026

RITSEI v0.2.0 is the follow-up source snapshot after the v0.1.0 baseline. It adds bounded
Procurement, Process Studio, integration, financial-readiness, and invariant-hardening foundations.

## Highlights

- Expanded Process Studio governance with immutable release artifacts, validation, operator
  controls, checkpoints, and governed studio lanes.
- Added bounded external integration contracts and provider-neutral HTTPS connector foundations.
- Added experimental Process Pack distribution foundations.
- Added generic Fallow static-analysis adoption and additional financial readiness evidence.
- Continued hardening of compatibility, reliability, and roadmap gate evidence.

These notes are curated from the release-preparation history and validated against the annotated
tag target.

## Scope and limitations

This is a pre-release, source-only snapshot. It has no published build artifact, installer,
container image, or production deployment guarantee. The planned Process Studio and connector work
remains bounded by the canonical architecture and roadmap gates; experimental or gated capabilities
must not be represented as generally available product features.

Do not treat the tag as a database upgrade contract. Review migrations, PostgreSQL requirements,
package/API/capability compatibility, backups, reconciliation evidence, and manual recovery
procedures before upgrading. No automatic rollback or forward-compatibility promise is implied.

See the [release workflow](../../docs/development/releasing.md),
[roadmap](../../docs/roadmap/README.md), and
[Process Studio architecture](../../docs/architecture/process-studio.md).
